facts.statement: The sample extract contains real data including names, DOBs, and some diagnosis codes.
facts.quote: Pranav opened it here and forwarded to Sneha and Vikram in Pune to start profiling. 'It's real data I think — names, DOBs, some diagnosis codes.'
facts.whyItMatters: Patient data has moved to Pune for profiling.

facts.statement: Daniel Ortiz, a freelance data engineer in Austin, will be used for the project.
facts.quote: Dhaval: the BAA says nobody outside the US touches patient data, so he's bringing in Daniel Ortiz, freelance data engineer in Austin. Contractor agreement + NDA drafted on our US template.
facts.whyItMatters: Daniel Ortiz will be involved in the project, but the BAA restricts US-based personnel from handling patient data.

facts.statement: The BAA requires $5M cyber insurance, while the company's policy is $1M.
facts.quote: C-046 (BAA): Rebecca: must be signed together with the MSA. BAA wants $5M cyber insurance - ours is $1M (K)
facts.whyItMatters: There is a gap in cyber insurance coverage that needs to be addressed.

facts.statement: The MSA and BAA need to be signed by 1 Oct.
facts.quote: Dhaval: Rebecca needs MSA + BAA by 1 Oct.
facts.whyItMatters: There is a specific deadline for signing the MSA and BAA.
